name: image-search
description: Image search returning image/thumbnail/source URLs. Zero-key DuckDuckGo images backend (vqd token + i.js), or Brave Images API when BRAVE_API_KEY is set. Same backend-selection convention as web-search.
use_when: finding visual references — diagrams, pinouts, layouts, photos

args.name: --backend auto|ddg|brave
args.description: auto = brave if BRAVE_API_KEY set else ddg.

stdout: JSON {results: [{title, image_url, thumb_url, source_url, width, height}]}.
notes: DDG images uses an unofficial token flow and may break; prefer --backend brave for stability.
